title: Community Health II (DPH2103): Main Exam, Tue 31st March, 2026
department: Department of Community Health, Epidemiology and Biostatistics

items.text: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS. EACH QUESTION CARRIES 5 MARKS
Define professionalism in community health practice and state FOUR characteristics of a professional health worker.
Define Primary Health Care (PHC) and state FOUR key features of PHC.
State FIVE principles of Primary Health Care.
List FIVE strategies used in the implementation of Primary Health Care programmes.
State FIVE roles of the community in the implementation of Primary Health Care programmes.
Identify FIVE major determinants of health that influence the health status of a community.
State FIVE roles of a Health Records and Information Officer in Primary Health Care programmes.
